### What is BX-35?

It is Takara Tomy's Random Booster release in the Beyblade X line. The stock configuration and package conditions are listed above.

### Does BX-35 include a launcher and stadium?

No. A compatible Beyblade X launcher and stadium are needed separately.

## Sources and safety [...] Beyblade X BX-35 Random Booster Vol.04 is a genuine Takara Tomy Beyblade X random booster released in Japan on 2024-07-13. BX Basic Line uses a balanced metal-centered Blade construction with metal launcher hooks. Black Shell 4-60D is the featured pull in this six-way assortment. Its downward-facing guard surfaces, low Ratchet and Dot bit are arranged to survive attacks arriving below the Blade.

A random booster that contains one of the six types of beyblades that have been customized with a special color. The rare is "Black Shell 4-60D". A beyblade that is excellent at withstanding attacks from a low position with a blade with a downward defense blade, a low ratchet and a bit that is difficult to push out.
